privacy.title: Privacy Policy & GDPR Compliance
privacy.intro: CyberGuard is engineered to meet strict GDPR data minimization and privacy standards (DR-01). We collect only what is necessary to track training progress and secure your account.
privacy.s1Body: During registration, we store your chosen username, email address, and a securely hashed password (using bcrypt). We also store mission progress (completed levels and scores) to maintain your training status.
privacy.s2BodyBefore: Conversations with Cipher (the AI mentor) are
privacy.s2BodyAfter: . Your chat messages and history are sent transiently to generate responses via the Groq API and are never permanently logged or associated with your identity in our database.
privacy.s3Body: Under GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure), you have the absolute right to delete your account at any time. You can instantly self-delete your account and all associated progress data via your profile dashboard, or contact an administrator to purge all records.
privacy.s4Body: For security inquiries, vulnerability reporting, or data export requests, contact the CyberGuard security team through your institutional administrator.
